info.title: API.SH: Dosenbach
info.description: The Dosenbach API from API.SH: public Dosenbach data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Online availability of one product colour: per size the variant id, EU/UK/US size, EAN, stock quantity, in-stock flag and price (value, CHF, label), with the totals and the other colours. Lighter than the product endpoint.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dosenbach-availability

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product id (the number at the end of a product link, e.g. 141075; each colour has its own id), or a dosenbach.ch product link (`url` is accepted as the same thing; a link also sets the market and language).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default), fr or it. A product or category link sets it from its path (/de-ch/, /fr-ch/, /it-ch/).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The site's category menu as a tree (women, men, kids, then shoes, sports, clothing, accessories, brands, sale and their sub-categories): name, category id and link of every entry, in the market's language. Use the ids with `/dosenbach/v1/category`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dosenbach-categories

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default), fr or it. A product or category link sets it from its path (/de-ch/, /fr-ch/, /it-ch/).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products of a category (e.g. women's sneakers) or a brand page, with the same product fields, filters, sort and paging as search, and the category's name, path, parent and child ids and link. Category ids and links come from `/dosenbach/v1/categories`, product `category_ids` and search `suggested_categories`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dosenbach-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category id, a dosenbach.ch category link (/c/...-<id>), a brand page link (/b/<brand>-<id>) or a gender page (/damen, /herren, /kinder or the market's own words). `url` and `id` are accepted as the same thing.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand filter, comma = any of: a name (adidas) or an id from `facets`.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour filter, comma = any of: a colour name in the market's language or an id from `facets`.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender: women, men, unisex (or the site's own word), or an id from `facets`.

parameters.name: age_group
parameters.description: Age group (adults, teens, kids, babies in the market's language) or an id from `facets`.

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Product type (sneakers, boots, sandals, ...; names or ids from `facets`).

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Sport filter (names or ids from `facets`).

parameters.name: size_eu
parameters.description: EU size, comma = any of (e.g. 38,39).

parameters.name: size_uk
parameters.description: UK size, comma = any of.

parameters.name: size_us
parameters.description: US size, comma = any of.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Letter or other size (S, M, L, ...), comma = any of.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Shoe width (names or ids from `facets`).

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Outer material (leather, textile, ...; names or ids from `facets`).

parameters.name: on_sale
parameters.description: 1 = reduced products only.

parameters.name: new
parameters.description: 1 = new products only.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in the market's currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in the market's currency.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any other filter the listing offers as facet:value (repeatable), with `facets[].code` and a value name or id.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recommended (default), relevance, newest, price_asc, price_desc, discount.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-100 (default 48).

parameters.name: with_sizes
parameters.description: 1 = add every size with its online stock and EAN to the first 24 products (`sizes`; without it a listing gives the total stock and `in_stock` only).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default), fr or it. A product or category link sets it from its path (/de-ch/, /fr-ch/, /it-ch/).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product colour: product id, product code, article and manufacturer numbers, colour and colour id with the manufacturer's colour name, brand, prices (value, CHF, label: current, before sale, discount), every size (EU/UK/US/cm, thirds shown as 36 2/3) with variant id, EAN, online stock quantity and price, the size table, the other colours with ids and links, description, all attributes (materials, lining, sole, fastening, ...), the manufacturer, images and the product's links in the brand's other shops.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dosenbach-product

get.description:
Products to suggest next to a product: `similar` (default) gives other models of the same product type in the product's gender section; `carousel` gives the product page's own suggestion carousel (products of the product's category). Same product fields as search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dosenbach-recommendations

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products, 1-48 (default 12).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: similar (default) or carousel.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: 1 = only products in stock.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default), fr or it. A product or category link sets it from its path (/de-ch/, /fr-ch/, /it-ch/).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the Dosenbach shop (Switzerland, prices in CHF). Each product is one colour: product id, colour and colour id, brand, price and the price before a sale (value, CHF, label), discount, total online stock, the other colours (every size with its stock and EAN with `with_sizes=1`), images, gender and product type, plus the listing's filters with counts (`facets`) and the categories the term matches. The site's sort and every filter it offers. Page with `page` (`next_page`, null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dosenbach-search

get.description:
Stock of one product colour in Dosenbach stores near a place: each store with address, phone, opening hours, distance and the quantity per size (EU/UK/US size, EAN). Give a town or postcode in the market's country, or lat and lng.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dosenbach-store-availability

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product id (the number at the end of a product link, e.g. 141075; each colour has its own id), or a dosenbach.ch product link (`url` is accepted as the same thing; a link also sets the market and language).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A town or postcode in the market's country. `zip` and `city` are accepted as the same thing. Not needed when lat and lng are given.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, instead of location.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude, instead of location.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius in km, 1-300 (default 30).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default), fr or it. A product or category link sets it from its path (/de-ch/, /fr-ch/, /it-ch/).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every Dosenbach store in the market: store code, name, address, phone, coordinates, opening hours per weekday and exceptions, services, click and collect, and the store page link. Optional text filter and paging.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dosenbach-stores

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Filter by name, town, postcode or street.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number when page_size is set.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Stores per page (default: all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
What the search box suggests for a term: matching categories and brand pages (id, name, path, link), the page the site opens for the term (`redirect`) and the top products with their prices.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dosenbach-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The typed term.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Category suggestions, 1-20 (default 6).

parameters.name: products
parameters.description: Top products to include, 0-24 (default 4).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, texts and links: de (default), fr or it. A product or category link sets it from its path (/de-ch/, /fr-ch/, /it-ch/).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
